title: Convergence with the quantifiers changed
promptMarkdown: Enumerate the dyadic half-open intervals of $[0,1)$ level by level: at level $k$ use $[j2^{-k},(j+1)2^{-k})$, $j=0,\ldots,2^k-1$. Let $(h_n)$ be their indicators in that order. Prove $h_n\to0$ in every finite $L^p$, but $h_n(x)$ fails to converge for every $x\in[0,1)$. Explain why the subsequence consequence of Lᵖ convergence is not contradicted.
hintLadder: Keep the dyadic level separate from the single enumeration index.
Count hits and misses for a fixed point at each level.
